gloss: successive, all previous, through the ages

definitions.explanation: Refers to all holders of a position or all instances across generations. Used as a modifier before nouns to mean "every successive" or "all previous."

examples.japanese: {歴代|れきだい}の{大統領|だいとうりょう}の{名前|なまえ}を{覚|おぼ}える。
examples.english: To memorize the names of all previous presidents.

examples.japanese: この{記録|きろく}は{歴代|れきだい}{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: This is the all-time best record.

examples.japanese: {歴代|れきだい}の{首相|しゅしょう}の{中|なか}で{最|もっと}も{在任|ざいにん}{期間|きかん}が{長|なが}かったのは{誰|だれ}ですか。
examples.english: Who among all the previous prime ministers had the longest term in office?

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a modifier before a noun: {歴代|れきだい}の + noun or {歴代|れきだい} + noun (without の). Refers to all people or things that have held a particular role or position across successive generations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴代|れきだい}{最高|さいこう}: all-time best/highest
- {歴代|れきだい}{最多|さいた}: most ever, all-time most
- {歴代|れきだい}の{首相|しゅしょう}: all successive prime ministers
- {歴代|れきだい}の{社長|しゃちょう}: all successive company presidents
- {歴代|れきだい}{一位|いちい}: number one of all time
